canonical_clinical_fact_schema.implementation: Canonical Fact carries clinical assertion, uncertainty, temporality, action, relations, evidence, source modality, and a derived review state. Draft validation rejects duplicate/self/unknown relation targets and duplicate relation edges.

limitations: Developer-authored synthetic and application tests only; no independent clinical annotation or patient safety validation.
No clinical release authorization is implied.
